name: Shounin Ryoujoku ~To*neko Taloon no Mazodorei~
original_name: 商人陵辱 ～ト●ネコのマゾ奴隷～
source:
Disaster has befallen adventurous merchant Torn*ko Taloon from Dr*gon Quest! 
He is assaulted by a thief and his gang... 
But Torn*ko turns out to love it. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065725.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《勇者斗恶龙》中的冒险商人托恩*科塔隆遭遇了灾难！
他遭到小偷和他的团伙的袭击…… 
但事实证明，Torn*ko很喜欢它。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065725.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
